blocks.text: Savol: Are you working? What are you doing?

Present Continuous savoli 2-darsdagi **be** savollari kabi yasaladi: **am / is / are** egadan **oldinga** chiqadi, fe'lning **-ing** shakli esa egadan keyin, o'z joyida qoladi. You **are working** → **Are** you **working**? O'zbekchada esa so'z tartibi o'zgarmaydi, fe'lga `-mi` qo'shiladi: «Ishlayapsiz» → «Ishlayapsiz**mi**?». Inglizcha savolda **am / is / are** va **-ing** bir-biridan ajraladi, ega esa ularning o'rtasida turadi.
Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I am. / No, she isn't.

Qisqa javobda faqat **am / is / are** qaytariladi, **-ing** fe'l takrorlanmaydi: Are you working? — Yes, I **am**. («Yes, I am working» ham to'g'ri, lekin uzun.) Qoidalar 2-darsdagidek: ijobiy javobda qisqa shakl yo'q (Yes, I am — «Yes, I'm» emas), inkorda esa ikki xil qisqa shakl bor: No, he **isn't** = No, he**'s not**.

items.text: Is the kettle boiling? — Yes, **it is**.
Are Tom and Emma dancing? — No, **they aren't**.
items.translation: Tom bilan Emma raqs tushishyaptimi? — Yo'q, **tushishmayapti**.

blocks.text: So'roq so'zlari bilan: What are you doing?

So'roq so'zi doim gap boshida turadi: so'roq so'zi + **am / is / are** + ega + fe'l**-ing**. Eng ko'p ishlatiladigan savol — **What are you doing?** («Nima qilyapsan?»). O'zbekchada «nima» kesimning oldida, gap o'rtasida turadi, inglizchada esa **what** — eng oldinda. **is** so'zlashuvda qisqaradi: **What's** he doing? **Where's** she going?

items.translation: Aziz anavi katta sumka bilan **qayerga** ketyapti?

blocks.text: Predlog gap oxirida: Who are you waiting for?

Ko'p fe'llar ma'lum predlog bilan ishlatiladi: wait **for** (kutmoq), look **at** (qaramoq), look **for** (qidirmoq), listen **to** (tinglamoq), talk **to** (gaplashmoq), talk / think **about** (gaplashmoq / o'ylamoq ... haqida). So'roq so'zli savolda predlog fe'ldan ajramaydi va **gap oxirida** qoladi: **Who** are you waiting **for**? **What** are you looking **at**? O'zbekchada esa predlog o'rnidagi qo'shimcha so'roq so'zining o'ziga qo'shiladi: **kim**ni, **nima**ga, **nima** haqida.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «You are working?» → **Are you working?** (so'z tartibi); «What you are doing?» → **What are you doing?**; «What are you do?» → **What are you doing?** (`-ing` tushib qolmaydi); «Where you going?» → **Where are you going?** (**are** tushib qolmaydi); «For who are you waiting?» → **Who are you waiting for?**; «Yes, I'm.» → **Yes, I am.**
**What are you doing?** — «Hozir nima qilyapsan?», **What do you do?** esa — «Kasbingiz nima?». Ikkinchisi Present Simple savoli (7-dars). Ikkalasining farqi — 8-darsda.

Bog'lanish: **be** bilan savollar va qisqa javoblar — 2-dars; Present Continuous tasdiq va inkori — 3-dars; kelajak rejalari haqida savol (What **are** you **doing** tomorrow?) — 25-dars; predlog oxirida keladigan savollar batafsil — 46-dars.

examples.title: **Are** you **working**? **Is** it **raining**?
examples.description: Ha / yo'q savoli: **am / is / are** egadan oldinga chiqadi, **-ing** shakli joyida qoladi: You are working → **Are** you **working**?

sentences.text: **Are** you **listening** to me?
**Is** it **raining** in Tashkent?
**Is** your brother **sleeping**? The light is off.
Excuse me, **are** you **using** this chair?
**Are** the children **having** fun at the party?
Dilnoza, **is** the water **boiling**?
**Am** I **speaking** too fast for you?
Tom, **are** you **wearing** my jacket again?
**Is** Madina still **talking** on the phone?
So **are** your parents **enjoying** their holiday in Antalya?

examples.title: Short answers: **Yes, I am.** / **No, she isn't.**
examples.description: Qisqa javobda faqat **am / is / are** qaytariladi, **-ing** fe'l takrorlanmaydi: Are you working? — Yes, I **am**. / No, I**'m not**.

sentences.text: Are you enjoying the film? — Yes, **I am**.
Is Aziz doing his homework? — No, **he isn't**.
Is the baby crying? — No, **she's not**. She's laughing.
Are your friends waiting outside? — Yes, **they are**.
Sorry, am I sitting in your seat? — No, **you aren't**.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, sizning o'rningizda o'tiribmanmi? — Yo'q, **o'tirganingiz yo'q**.

sentences.text: Is it still snowing? — Yes, **it is**, and it's very cold.
sentences.translation: Hali ham qor yog'yaptimi? — Ha, **yog'yapti**, juda sovuq.

sentences.text: Bekzod, are you watching this? — No, **I'm not**. It's boring.
Are Emma and James playing tennis today? — Yes, **they are**.
sentences.translation: Emma bilan Jeyms bugun tennis o'ynashyaptimi? — Ha, **o'ynashyapti**.

sentences.text: Mum, is my phone charging? — No, **it isn't**. The cable is broken.
sentences.translation: Oyi, telefonim quvvat olyaptimi? — Yo'q, **olmayapti**. Kabel buzilgan.

sentences.text: And is Grandma feeling better today? — Yes, **she is**, thank you.
sentences.translation: Buvingiz bugun o'zini yaxshiroq his qilyaptimi? — Ha, **yaxshiroq**, rahmat.

examples.title: **What are** you **doing**? **Where is** she **going**?
examples.description: So'roq so'zi + **am / is / are** + ega + fe'l**-ing**: **What** are you doing? **Where** is he going? **Who** are you calling?

sentences.text: **What are** you **doing**? — I'm making tea.
**Where is** Bekzod **going** in such a hurry?
**What is** Sarah **cooking** for dinner?
**Who are** you **calling** at this time?
Hey, **what are** you **reading**? — A detective story.
**Where are** you **staying** in London?
Madina, **what are** the children **watching**?
**What are** they **building** across the road?
Sorry, **where are** we **going** now? I'm a bit lost.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, endi **qayerga ketyapmiz**? Biroz adashib qoldim.

sentences.text: **Where's** Aziz **working** these days?

examples.title: **Why are** you **laughing**? **How is** it **going**?
examples.description: **why** (nega?) va **how** (qanday? qalay?) bilan savollar. **How's it going?** — «Ishlar qalay?» degan tayyor ibora.

sentences.text: **Why are** you **laughing**?
**How's** your new job **going**?
**Why is** the dog **barking** so loudly?
Emma, **why are** you **wearing** a coat? It's hot today!
sentences.translation: Emma, **nega** palto kiyib olding? Bugun issiq-ku!

sentences.text: **How are** your studies **going**, Dilnoza?
**Why is** everybody **looking** at me?
So **how is** your grandfather **feeling** today?
sentences.translation: Xo'sh, bobongiz bugun o'zini **qanday his qilyapti**?

sentences.text: Excuse me, **why is** the train **stopping** here?
Hi, Tom! **How's** it **going**? — Not bad, thanks.
sentences.translation: Salom, Tom! Ishlar **qalay**? — Yomon emas, rahmat.

sentences.text: Aziz, **why aren't** you **eating**? Are you ill?

examples.title: Who are you **waiting for**? — prepositions at the end
examples.description: Ko'p fe'llar predlog bilan keladi: wait **for**, look **at**, look **for**, listen **to**, talk **to** / **about**, think **about**. Savolda predlog gap oxirida qoladi: **Who** are you waiting **for**?

sentences.text: **Who are** you **waiting for**?
**What are** you **looking at**? — The birds on the roof.
**What's** Madina **thinking about**? She's very quiet.
**Who's** Tom **talking to**? — His boss, I think.
sentences.translation: Tom **kim bilan** gaplashyapti? — Boshlig'i bilan, shekilli.

sentences.text: **What are** they **laughing at**?
Aziz, **what are** you **listening to**? Is it a new song?
Sorry, **who are** you **looking for**? — Mr Davies, the manager.
And **what are** the students **talking about**? — The exams, of course.
sentences.translation: Talabalar-chi, **nima haqida** gaplashishyapti? — Imtihonlar haqida, albatta.

sentences.text: **Who is** Bekzod **writing to** — his mum?
Excuse me, **what is** everybody **queuing for**?

examples.title: Dialogue: a late phone call
examples.description: Telefon suhbati: ha / yo'q savollari, so'roq so'zli savollar va qisqa javoblar bir vaziyatda.

sentences.text: — Hello, Madina! **Are** you **sleeping**?
— No, **I'm not**. I'm reading in bed. Why?
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, **uxlamayapman**. To'shakda kitob o'qiyapman. Nima edi?

sentences.text: — Listen, **are** you **doing** anything important right now?
— Not really. **Where are** you **calling** from? It's very noisy.
sentences.translation: — Unchalik emas. **Qayerdan qo'ng'iroq qilyapsan**? Juda shovqin.

sentences.text: — I'm at the station. **I'm waiting** for the last train.
— **Is** it **coming**? It's very late.
— No, **it isn't**. Nobody **is telling** us anything.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, **kelmayapti**. Hech kim bizga hech narsa **aytmayapti**.

sentences.text: — Oh no! **Are** you **standing** outside in the cold?
— No, I'm sitting in a café, and **I'm drinking** hot tea.
— Good. Wait there — **I'm getting** in the car now!
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi. O'sha yerda kut — hozir **mashinaga o'tiryapman**!

examples.title: Questions about now: **these days**, **this year**
examples.description: Hozirgi davrdagi vaqtinchalik holat haqida savollar: **Are** you **studying** this year? What **is** he **doing** these days?

sentences.text: **Are** you **working** this summer, or **are** you **resting**?
**What is** your sister **studying** at university?
**Is** James still **living** in Manchester?
These days, **what are** you **reading**? Anything good?
sentences.translation: Shu kunlarda **nima o'qiyapsan**? Biror yaxshi narsa bormi?

sentences.text: **Are** your parents **staying** with you this week?
**How is** Aziz **doing** at his new school?
**Is** the city **building** a new metro line this year?
sentences.translation: Shahar bu yil yangi metro liniyasini **quryaptimi**?

sentences.text: Bekzod, **are** you **learning** any new languages at the moment?
**Where are** Sarah and Tom **living** now — in Oxford or London?
sentences.translation: Sara bilan Tom hozir **qayerda yashashyapti** — Oksforddami yoki Londondami?

sentences.text: Tell me, **are** prices **going up** in Samarkand too?

examples.title: Mixed: questions and answers
examples.description: Mustahkamlash: ha / yo'q savollari, so'roq so'zli savollar va to'liq javoblar aralash.

sentences.text: **Is** Dilnoza **cooking**? — Yes, she's making manti.
**What are** you **drinking**? — Just water, thanks.
**Are** we **going** the right way? — I'm not sure, really.
sentences.translation: To'g'ri yo'ldan **ketyapmizmi**? — Rostini aytsam, aniq bilmayman.

sentences.text: **Why is** Bekzod **running**? — He's late for his lesson.
Mum, **are** you **using** the laptop? — Yes, I am, sorry.
**Who are** Emma and Sarah **waiting for**? — Their teacher.
**Where are** you **sitting**? — In row 12, near the exit.
**Is** it **getting** dark outside? — Yes, it is, and it's getting cold too.
sentences.translation: Tashqarida **qorong'i tushyaptimi**? — Ha, sovuq ham tushyapti.

sentences.text: **What's** your brother **doing** in Tashkent this month? — He's working at a hotel.
sentences.translation: Akangiz bu oy Toshkentda **nima qilyapti**? — Mehmonxonada ishlayapti.

sentences.text: Aziz, **are** you **listening**, or **are** you **thinking** about football again?
